other_conditions: Must be a citizen of India.
Must perform a spectacular act of bravery either inside Odisha or by an Odisha resident outside the state.
The act of bravery must have occurred between 1 January and 31 December of the preceding year.
Applicant must not have been convicted of any criminal offence.
The award can be given only once to a person in his/her lifetime.
Award may be cancelled and recovered if obtained fraudulently.
The award can be given posthumously to the next of kin.
If more than one person is involved in the act, the cash award will be shared among them.
The department is not obligated to confer the award every year.
benefits_summary: Cash award of ₹1,00,000, a silver medal, a scroll and travel & accommodation arrangements for the award ceremony.
